raw_result.summary: Plan-only ACCEPT. The current lease has a private root path and handle but no callable internal operation; ID-I06 and the navigation contract now define that missing seam within Story 18.2's accepted shared-workspace ownership. UseContainedRootAsync is Infrastructure-only, purpose-specific, serialized with disposal, bounded to root binding, state separation and contained URI mapping, and checks exact live authority and pinned root identity before and after its short callback. Its scope is invalidated afterward; only sanitized status and contained relative locations may leave, while a trusted launch binding requires another check immediately before launch. Long JDT waits and Worker disclosure remain outside the lease gate. The operation does not claim subprocess containment, alter Story 18.1's public read contract, or authorize Story 18.3 to consume the older checkpoint; 18.3 requires an updated verified checkpoint and separate integration authority. This is a bounded correction within the accepted plan, not a human-reserved architecture change outside it. Ordered prior raw plan reviews 01–07 and definition reviews 01–05 were read: P-PATH-TRUST-01, T-PATH-LAUNCH-ORDER-01, P-PARTIAL-OPEN-OWNERSHIP-01 and T-RUNTIME-SETTINGS-SEAM-01 remain resolved; no new plan finding was identified. Deterministic explicit implementation-design validation returned no errors. Current tasks were not judged in this plan-only review. diff_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical sorted path-to-artifact-SHA256 JSON encoded as UTF-8 with a terminal newline.
